title: Decision: rusqlite bundled feature for musl cross-compile
description: rusqlite is configured with features = ["bundled"] in workspace.dependencies. This embeds SQLite source and avoids the need for libsqlite3-dev in musl cross-compile environments. Eliminates a major friction point for building static binaries on aarch64 and x86_64 musl targets, which are the deployment targets.
notes: opinion: no engineering basis — this is a rationale note affirming a correct existing decision (rusqlite bundled feature is correct for musl cross-compile). Not a finding. No action needed.
